task.description:
Run the FULL project test suite on `feature/WF03-ISS0179-20260821` (already checked out) before this branch merges. The change under test (`test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs`'s advisory-lock serialization) already passed its own module's tests (10/10, independently re-run twice) and idiom review -- this step is the full-suite regression check the merge step will otherwise be trusting blind.

Use `sh scripts/test_parallel.sh` per this project's standard full-suite mechanism, with `TEST_PARALLEL_N=4` on this host (the default nproc-based N is known to saturate the shared Postgres pool at `mix ecto.create` time on this specific 16-core host -- ISS-0212/ISS-0194 already cover this, no need to re-derive it, just use the override).

ATTRIBUTE EVERY FAILURE STRUCTURALLY, per `core-directives.md`'s 'Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching' -- this suite carries a standing set of pre-existing failures and 'green' means no failure attributable to this branch, not zero failures. For each failure: is the failing module or its dependencies in `git diff --name-only main...feature/WF03-ISS0179-20260821`? The only file this branch changes is `test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs` -- if a failure is in that module, it needs a genuine causal argument (not just presence), since it is exactly the module this run just changed.

Write the test report per this project's convention (`test/reports/`) and record it in `artifacts_out`.
acceptance_criteria: The full suite was actually run via TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 sh scripts/test_parallel.sh and real pass/fail counts are quoted
Every failure is attributed structurally, never by count-matching against a prior run
Any failure in test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs specifically is checked for a genuine causal connection to this run's own change, not cleared by assumption
A test report is written to test/reports/ and listed in artifacts_out
